line: 邗. imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is still here, which means the window is not empty. Despair says the dark is the whole truth. Hope is the fidelity of looking again. Sociology calls this a household that can last. The older word is faithfulness.

z: 邙 imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line: 邙. imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu wants the pain copied, so the books will balance. They will not. Mercy is this part refusing to become the injury. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.

z: 邛 imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line: 邛. imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele meets the blow first. Anger wants a face to burn. Turned, the same force becomes the wall in front of the smaller body. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.

z: 邡 imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line: 邡. imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla can be held up to be admired, or held up so the person is not crushed. Pride needs someone lower. Dignity lets them stand. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.

z: 邢 imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line: 邢. imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu looks, and the look can steal or it can bless. Envy is love that demands the good thing shrink. Admiration lets it shine. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.

z: 邦 imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line: 邦. imisipha, ithambo elibanzi lehlombe, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu counts what could be lost. That count is love doing arithmetic. Courage is not a louder voice. It is this part staying in the room. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.

z: 邨 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line: 邨. umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu closes when it thinks tomorrow is empty. Greed is that closing. Generosity is the same hand remembering the table. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.

z: 邯 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line: 邯. umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele is near the place speech begins. The tongue can cut a family in one extra sentence. Healing speech tells the truth and refuses the insult. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.

z: 邰 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line: 邰. umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla is easy to overlook because it works. Contempt is the shortcut that will not look. Appreciation is looking that stays. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.

z: 邱 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line: 邱. umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu can be in the room while the person has left. That is the punishing silence. Presence is the same quiet, warmed by staying. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
practice: Put the glowing thing down. Let this part of you be seen. You do not have to perform a talk.

z: 邳 umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line: 邳. umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu remembers a break. Betrayal proves the bond was real. Forgiveness does not pretend the bowl never cracked. It eats from the bowl with the crack still gold. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.

line: 邵. umsipha wehlombe, ihlombe, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele aches where love has nowhere to go. Grief is not an invader. Compassion is that ache sitting down beside someone else's wound. Psychology calls this a treatment. It is also a way of sitting at a table.
